title: Tech Note: Implementing Singleton Classes with Static Member Functions in 4D
author: Dominique Delahaye, 4D Expert, 4D SAS.
featured_technology: OB Class, OB Copy, OB Remove commands

historical_commentary.text: The singleton-via-static-shared-collection-plus-reference-counting pattern described here is a legitimate, still-usable OOP technique in 4D classes, and 4D classes/OOP themselves have only grown more central since v18R3; however, native support for true static class properties/members was added to the 4D language in later versions, which now provides a more direct way to implement statics/singletons than this shared-object workaround.
related_updates: 4D later added native static properties and shared singleton class support directly in the language/framework, reducing the need for the manual has_static/get_static workaround shown here
4D classes and OOP (Class Constructor, Class extends, Function, etc.) introduced ~v17R5-18 have remained the standard and continued to mature since this note
Shared objects/collections with Use...End use remain the correct primitive for cross-process concurrency control in 4D, unchanged
